newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO UNDERLINES ARC POTENTIAL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO UNDERLINES ARC POTENTIAL.

text.p: Helissio cemented his position as Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe favourite with an impressive display in the Group Two Prix Niel (12f) at Longchamp on Sunday.
The Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud winner, trained by Elie Lellouche, made all the running to win by a comfortable length from Darazari.
In the other major Arc trial of the day, the Group Three Prix Foy, Andre Fabre's Swain, third in the Arc last year, upset the British challenger, Pentire.

The early tempo was very modest and Michael Hills was the subject of criticism after taking a calculated gamble in kicking on Pentire, only to be passed and beaten by Swain by a margin of half a length.
Geoff Wragg, Pentire's trainer, said: "He can never win a race from the front and events went against him here. He must come from behind."
British filly, My Emma, a 29-1 shot, creating a big upset by winning the Group One Prix Vermeille over a mile and half.
The race had a less happy outcome for the Irish jockey, Johnny Murtagh, whose mount Zafzala was demoted from second to fifth. The rider also received a four day ban for careless riding.
